scenes.headline: How Fish Audio S2 turns text into speech
scenes.sub: A slow model over time, a fast one over codebooks.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Anchovy! Fish Audio's open speech model runs two language models: one steps through time, one through depth.

scenes.text: A big model steps once per audio frame; a four-layer model fills that frame's ten codebooks, so the sequence stays short.
scenes.say: The idea: a big model steps once per audio frame, and a four-layer model fills that frame's ten codebooks.

steps.say: Text goes into the slow model, a thirty-six layer Qwen stack. A tag like whispers sweetly is just more text.
Once per frame, it picks one semantic token out of four thousand and ninety-six, carrying the words and rough prosody.
Its hidden state seeds the four-layer fast model, which climbs the codebooks, adding nine acoustic tokens.
All ten tokens are embedded and summed into the slow model's next input. One position per frame keeps the context short.
The causal codec decoder turns each frame into about forty-six milliseconds of audio, so sound can stream.
In the report's own figure, the system prompt holds the reference text and audio, then the target text.
Above it, the fast model stacks codebooks one to nine on every semantic token.

left.title: Dedicated control tokens
left.say: One way to steer a voice is dedicated control tokens, a vocabulary to maintain.

right.title: Tags are plain text
right.say: This model has none. Bracketed phrases are plain text, learned from captioned transcripts and scored by the same captioner in training.

scenes.label: English tag activation rate, against 0.626 for S1
scenes.note: Fish Audio's own benchmark, judged by Gemini 3 Pro
scenes.say: On Fish Audio's own benchmark, judged by Gemini three Pro, it performs eighty-eight percent of English tags, against sixty-three for the previous model.

scenes.text: In S2, speaking style is ordinary text: the model learned to perform whatever the captioner wrote.
scenes.say: Speaking style here is ordinary text. The model learned to perform whatever the captioner wrote.

recap: One slow pass, ten fast passes per frame
Ten codebooks summed into one input
Tags and speakers are plain text
scenes.say: To recap: one slow pass and ten fast passes per frame, codebooks summed into one input, and tags that are just text.
